The job-array shard of this process

Source: R/slurm.R
sim_shard.Rd

Reads the Slurm array task (SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID) and the number of tasks (TIDYAGSIM_TASKS, set by write_slurm_array(), or SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_COUNT). Outside an array it returns NULL, so the same script both runs a shard and, run once more without an array, collects the finished study.

Usage

sim_shard()

Value

c(task, n_tasks) or NULL.
